    • newMove

      public void newMove(String text, int color, int oldR, int oldC, int newR, int newC, String promote, String sound)
      Parameters:
      text - - text of the notation
      color - - color of the move
      oldR - - the old row of the moving piece
      oldC - - the old column of the moving piece
      newR - - the new row of the moving piece
      newC - - the new column of the moving piece
      promote - - the string of the type of piece promoted to
      sound - - the sound of the move creates a new SavedMove object based on the information above creates the JButton for the move and the JLabel for the move number (if needed) also writes to the file if the game is being saved

    • setSelected

      public void setSelected(int selected)
      Parameters:
      selected - - move to select sets the selected move and deselects the previous selected move also tells the board whether or not it is the most recent move if it is a previous move, also plays the sound of that move

    • saveGame

      public void saveGame(File file)
      Parameters:
      file - - file to save to initializes the file writer, writes all of the moves made before to the file, and sets save to true so that all following moves will be saved too

    • reset

      public void reset()
      resets this Notations object by deleting all saved moves and the corresponding JButtons and JLabels, also replaces the textArea

    • startPlayHere

      public boolean startPlayHere(boolean send)
      Parameters:
      send - - whether or not to send the message to the other client (prevents infintie loops)
      Returns:
      whether or not it successfully started play from a previous move starts play from the selected move if it is not the most recent move deletes all the saved moves and corresponding JButtons and JLabels after the move
